snippet.title: Winx Club: Moonlight Quest - Game Trailer
snippet.description:
The Winx are returning to gaming with Winx Club: Moonlight Quest, a new official title from Balio Studio coming in November 2026.

Players will take control of Bloom and freely explore the Magic Dimension, including iconic locations from the Winx Club universe. Bloom can also transform and fly around the world, while the adventure centers around the mysterious Festival of the 100 Moons.

The game will also feature 24 playable characters and 32 mini-games across four game modes, giving fans more ways to interact with the Winx universe beyond the main adventure.

Winx Club: Moonlight Quest is currently planned for PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2.
